titulo: From chat to agent: the four steps
lead: In chat, you drive the whole time, and when you close the window, the work stops. The agent reads your files, runs tasks, and keeps going while you do something else. The shift isn't switching models: it's changing where the work happens.
objetivo: say which step you're on today and what the next concrete move is.

aprende.t: The four steps and the order between them

secoes.sub: Each step builds on the one before. If you skip the first, you get stuck on the other three.

nos.detalhe: The agent (Claude Code or Codex) works inside a folder of yours, reads a rulebook (AGENTS.md), and you undo any mistake with Git. It's the foundation for everything that comes next.
With INTELECTO, an assistant of your own on Telegram, with memory and the style you define, using a cloud or local model.

nos.sub: Ten tasks and go to sleep
nos.detalhe: inemaccbot saves each request as a task, resumes from where it stopped, and halts at a gate when it needs your approval.
r7e, promoavatar, and the xviral channels (finviral, saudeviral, advviral) publishing regularly, with checked numbers and the source on screen.

secoes.volta: Each step reuses the one before: folder, rules, secrets, and gate
secoes.legenda: No miracles: there's no "render while you sleep" if the system doesn't run correctly.

rolagem_fim.texto: Each step reuses the one before: the terminal's folder and rules, the .env with the keys, the queue that holds the tasks, and the gate before what matters. That's why the order isn't optional.

secoes.sub: Click the situation that looks most like yours today.

texto: Start at step 1. Do the OSWork Quick and then right away the six exercises of sequence 1.
Goal for the first week: get to your folder using only the terminal and watch the agent create a file inside it.

exemplo.texto: Open the terminal and create the folder projetos/meu-primeiro-agente.

texto: You're already at step 1. Check that you have AGENTS.md, Git, and .env in .gitignore; if you do, move up to step 2.
Install your own Jarvis with INTELECTO and take its course.

exemplo.texto: Write the meu-jarvis.md before installing anything.

texto: Time for the queue. Before installing inemaccbot, run the homemade queue in 30 lines to understand entrada, feito, and falhou.
Then list 10 repetitive tasks and mark where you need a gate.

exemplo.texto: Fill in the table of 10 tasks, with at least two of them having a gate.

texto: Step 4. Use r7e for the format and finviral as the template for your niche's channel.
Write the niche rules before automating: with no queue and no gate, automating social media just means posting the wrong thing faster.

exemplo.texto: Pick 5 reference channels and write canais.md and regras.md.

secoes.sub: Copy it, fill it in, and save it in your project folder. It becomes the map of your training.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: What is the core difference between the chat and the agent?
opcoes: The agent works on your files and keeps going without you directing every step.
The agent uses a smarter model.
perguntas.explica: The shift isn't switching models: it's changing where the work happens. The agent reads your folder, runs tasks, and keeps working when you close the window.

opcoes: Because folders, the terminal, AGENTS.md, and secrets kept out of the text are the foundation for the other three.
Because the terminal is only required on Windows.
Because Jarvis only runs after a month of use.
Because the course requires a set order to issue a certificate.
perguntas.explica: Anyone who skips sequence 1 gets stuck in the other three. Assistant, queue, and social media use folders, rules, .env, and Git all the time.

perguntas.p: You already use Claude Code in your folder, and you have AGENTS.md and Git. What's the next step?
opcoes: Install the queue before the assistant.
Design and install your own Jarvis (step 2).
Go back to the chat to practice prompts.
perguntas.explica: With step 1 solid, the next one is your own assistant: design the meu-jarvis.md and install INTELECTO.
